defects: hf_nonneg requires 0 ≤ f x for all x ∈ ℝ, but gold only requires nonnegativity on Ioi 0 — hypothesis strengthened over an unnecessary domain
hf_antitone requires Antitone f globally on ℝ, but gold only requires AntitoneOn f (Icc 0 N) — hypothesis strengthened, and also loses the N-dependence of the antitonicity requirement

hf_integrable requires Integrable f (integrable over all of ℝ w.r.t. volume), but gold only requires IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0) — a much stronger and more restrictive hypothesis (in fact forces f to vanish a.e. on (-∞,0] given the other hypotheses), making the theorem apply to a strictly narrower class of functions than gold's
